name: Closing Door
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The closing door can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the closing door has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The closing door makes two Threshold Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Empty House Silence.

Actions.name: Threshold Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Empty House Silence
Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. If the target was already Frightened by this ability, it also takes 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.
Actions.gmQuote: the sound of a door closing in an empty house

lore: It is the residue of the last quiet moment before a house is left forever — an echo that learned silence is a hunger, and now shuts the living inside it, room by room.
